title: Choose the phosphor dossier composition
question: All three keep the Release Control Dossier layout and the Phosphor Run Log palette. Which composition should the frontend match?

options.label: Phosphor Evidence Dossier
options.thesis: The dossier layout translates directly into one crisp phosphor architecture plate and a three-part evidence rail.
options.viewport: Seven equal lifecycle modules dominate the left field while the evidence categories stay large and quiet on the right.
options.risk: The equal modules are clear but make every lifecycle stage feel equally important.

options.label: Active Trace Dossier
options.thesis: A selected lifecycle route burns bright while retraining remains visible as a fading afterimage.
options.viewport: The active route becomes the focal interaction, with compact evidence waveforms aligned in the right rail.
options.risk: The route focus is memorable but requires a clear default state before the visitor interacts.

options.label: Layered Trace Ledger
options.thesis: One continuous architecture schematic sits above a quiet ledger for pipeline, API, and drift evidence.
options.viewport: The main diagram, trace ledger, and evidence rail form three linked layers without turning into a card grid.
options.risk: The added ledger carries more engineering detail and increases first-viewport density.
